brief: A utensil holder with two bins that is waterproof and dishwasher safe.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Two adjacent hex-bin-full bins placed at 0,0,0 and 1,0,0 (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full) joined side-by-side, dressed with fork/spoon/knife props visible in look.
Configurator checks fit/collisions only; it does not verify materials, sealing, layer adhesion, or waterproofing. Parts are 3D-printed plastic in user-chosen material – cannot be claimed waterproof.
Configurator does not check heat, water, detergent resistance or food safety. 3D-printed material choice and dishwasher safety not verified by system – cannot be claimed dishwasher safe.

finish.summary: Built two-cell holder with two full-depth bins linked and staged with utensils; waterproof and dishwasher-safe claims cannot be met by the configurator – shape helps contain utensils but material safety not verified.

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
